questions.q: What is the denary value of the binary number 11010110?

questions.why: Split into nibbles: 1010 = A and 1111 = F, so AF.

questions.q: A logical shift left by 2 places is applied to 00001100 (12). What is the result?
questions.why: Bits move 2 places left and 0s fill the right: 00110000 = 48 = 12 × 4.

questions.q: Explain what an overflow error is and when it happens when two 8-bit binary numbers are added.
questions.model: An overflow error happens when the result of a calculation is too large to be stored in the available bits. When two 8-bit numbers are added and the answer is more than 255, it needs a ninth bit that cannot be stored, so the stored result is wrong.
points: result too large for the number of bits available
8-bit answer needs a 9th bit / is over 255
the 9th bit cannot be stored so the stored value is wrong
